title: Marketing website for IQRA Communication (mobile accessories & recharge shop)

requirements.text: Create a responsive marketing website for the business shown in the uploaded image, using the business name "IQRA COMMUNICATION" and positioning it as a mobile accessories + mobile recharge/service shop.

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders without errors and is responsive on mobile and desktop.
Brand name "IQRA COMMUNICATION" is prominently displayed in the header/hero.
Copy is in English across the site.

requirements.text: Add a homepage layout with clear sections: Hero (shop name + short tagline), Services, Products/Accessories highlight, Gallery (static images), and Contact (phone numbers and basic info).

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage includes distinct sections for Hero, Services, Products/Accessories, Gallery, and Contact.
Navigation (top nav or in-page anchors) allows jumping to each section.
All sections have sensible placeholder English text if exact details are not available in the image.

requirements.text: Populate the Contact section with phone numbers visible in the uploaded image: "9053030920" and "7027835322" (formatting allowed, numbers must match). Add click-to-call links (tel:).

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Contact section displays both numbers exactly: 9053030920 and 7027835322.
Each number is clickable and uses a tel: link.
Numbers are visible on mobile without truncation.

requirements.text: Add a simple "Inquiry" contact form (name, phone, message) that submits to the backend and shows success/error states.

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Form validates required fields and prevents empty submit.
On submit, data is stored via backend canister call and UI shows a success confirmation.
On backend failure, UI shows a readable error state without crashing.

requirements.text: Implement backend storage for inquiries in the single Motoko actor, including: createInquiry(name, phone, message) and an admin-only (authenticated) listInquiries() for viewing submissions.

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Inquiries are persisted in canister stable state (survive reload).
Unauthenticated users can create inquiries, but cannot list inquiries.
Authenticated admin can list inquiries (basic check using caller principal allowlist configured in code).

requirements.text: Provide an admin page in the frontend that requires Internet Identity login and displays the stored inquiries in a table (newest first).

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Admin page cannot be accessed without signing in via Internet Identity (redirect or gated UI).
Admin table shows at least: created time, name, phone, message.
Table loads via React Query and handles loading/empty/error states.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for a mobile shop brand: teal/green base with red accents, bold typography for headings, and clean card-based sections. Avoid blue/purple as primary colors.

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: A consistent color palette and typography are used across header, buttons, sections, and cards.
Primary colors are not blue/purple; teal/green with red accents is visibly used.
Site has a polished, coherent look (spacing, alignment, consistent component styles).

requirements.text: Add generated static images as assets in frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the hero and services/products sections.

quotes: اس کے لئے ویب سائٹ بناو

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Hero uses the generated banner image.
Services/Products section uses the generated icon set or illustrations.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
No third-party auth providers; only Internet Identity for admin access.
No external databases or cloud services.
nonGoals: Real-time chat or WhatsApp API integration (tel: links are fine).
Inventory management, order management, or POS features.

required: Wide hero banner illustration for a mobile accessories & repair/recharge shop (iqra-communication-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
Set of 6 simple flat icons: Recharge, Mobile Accessories, Screen Guard, Charger/Cable, Mobile Repair, Used Phones (iqra-services-icons.dim_1200x400.png)
